verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of performance at scale or of item caps for workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. API pagination and the X-Total-Count header are developer building blocks, not scale or limit guidance. The only performance comment is an anecdotal remark from a five-person team, which does not address large-scale behavior.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
